alignmentMetadataBoundary.finding: The two temporary search descriptors passed to e4fd5c initialize words +4 through +20, not +0 or +24. A32 e95110-e95174 confirms these stores. e4fd5c propagates source +24 into destination flags; e64a44 consumes source flag bit 0x04000000 for crop selection and can consume bit 0x2000. A32 e64aac/e64ad0/e64b30 confirms these reads. Motion frontend e5a7a0 reads only +4,+12,+16,+20.
alignmentMetadataBoundary.currentOwnedChoice: Search descriptor format and flags derive from object 0x28. This is an explicit intended-initialization choice, not established stock equivalence for arbitrary prior stack contents.
alignmentMetadataBoundary.consumerCensus: PipelineScratchCensus closed the retained preparation descriptor census: +24 reaches consumed flags, word0 propagates but is unread in this stage. Integration policy for a deliberate initialization deviation remains unresolved.

motionVectorBoundary.finding: A32 dad5fc/dad600 copies only two words into the vector output and dad604 writes vector+12; vector+8 is untouched. Coarse search dace24 writes vector+8 before refinement in modes 0,2,3. Mode 1 skips coarse search, so A32 e5a990/e5a998 then copies an uninitialized local word to caller vector2.
motionVectorBoundary.scope: Only the predicted-motion stage with frame+0x2788 != 1 selects mode 1 and publishes the tainted value at frame+0x31e4. Measured motion selects mode 2. Alignment selects mode 3 and ignores vector2. Predicted motion with references selects mode 0. Those coarse-search paths initialize vector2.
motionVectorBoundary.census: PipelineScratchCensus closed the vector path: only nonreference predicted mode 1 publishes the uninitialized local vector2. Its value reaches frame+0x31e4; it is not proven unobservable.
motionVectorBoundary.currentOwnedChoice: MotionEstimate initializes all four vectors to zero before the owned motion call. The no-coarse mode 1 zero is a deliberate initialization choice, not established stock parity.
